استعددن (form X)
# اِسْتَعْدَدْنَ (istaʕdadna) /is.taʕ.dad.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَعَدَّ (istaʕadda)
# اُسْتُعْدِدْنَ (ustuʕdidna) /us.tuʕ.did.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَعَدَّ (istaʕadda)
# اِسْتَعْدِدْنَ (istaʕdidna) /is.taʕ.did.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَعَدَّ (istaʕadda)
